name: Peak
_about: A PEAK: a stiff bill or rim -- a disc (clothes.js `brim`) of `radius` cranium radii centred `forward` of the head's middle at `at` high, tilted down at the front (its axis [-.18, -1, 0]: clothes.js takes a brim's axis as written, not as an expression -- a level rim is a piece of its own); its back half lies inside the crown it is sewn to, so only the bill shows: a baseball cap's, a hard hat's rim.
